messages:
anya: Flagging a small but sharp provisional token bump during last rolling deploy. Pattern: router handoff -> new session -> overlapping chunk credits.
sam: do we have a log snippet?
kevin: short trace: 
[2024-05-10T11:12:31Z] session=rz1 route=canary cb=tripped
[2024-05-10T11:12:31Z] session=rz1 tool=tts chunk=2 status=truncated
[2024-05-10T11:12:32Z] client retry new_session=rz1b orig_session=rz1
[2024-05-10T11:12:33Z] billing provisional session=rz1 tokens=95 chunks=[1,2]
[2024-05-10T11:12:33Z] billing provisional session=rz1b tokens=102 chunks=[2,3]

anya: root cause: provenance break on reconnect (router creates new session id). Ledger keys are session-scoped so chunk 2 double-counted.
lucy: proposal: reconciler chunk-fingerprint merge. Fingerprint = sha256(normalize(prompt)+model+chunk_index). Merge within 2m when truncation flag present OR small token/byte delta.
sam: alternative: router preserve request-id on reconnects behind a flag. That would skip heavy reconciler work. Which is lower risk?
kevin: preserving request-id is simple but could change trace topology for Dedicated customers. Safer path: add X-Session-Origin header on reconnects and reconciler merge only when origin present. Then iterate to fingerprint fallback.
anya: rollout plan: add feature.attach_session_origin -> canary -> 5% -> 50% -> 100%. Reconciler.chunk_merge behind feature flag; read-only mode first (compute merges but don't call billing).
billing-bot: For merge writes we'll accept POST /internal/billing/merge {merge_id, sessions, fingerprints, merged_tokens, reason}. Finance requests initial refund throttle 5/min.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled: router-canary-v4 -> canary-region -> 2024-05-11T02:00Z. /deploy router-canary-v4
kevin: I'll open PRs: router header + reconciler merge_id + metrics. Lucy to mock Console grouping UI. Sam to coordinate tests.
anya: Telemetry: router.session_origin_sent, reconciler.chunk_merge_attempts/successes, reconciler.merge_reject_no_origin. Console needs an annotation when merges happen.
lucy: will add collapsed "merged provisional" group and an expandable view showing pre-merge items plus trace link.
sam: good. If refunds spike, throttle and rollback. Thanks team :thumbsup:
